Commentary.Commentary: That is all we have for you tonight. India take a 1-0 lead in this 5-match ODI series. We now move to Visakhapatnam for the second ODI. That match is on 24th October, Wednesday, which begins at 1330 local (0800 GMT). Join in for that one. Till then, you can catch other cricketing action around the globe. Cheers!

Man of the Match and India captain, Virat Kohli, says he feels good as they won quite convincingly. Thinks Windies put a good score on the board but nothing is too difficult when Rohit is batting at the other end. Chuckles and says it rarely happens when Rohit plays second fiddle, but once in a while it happens as he was feeling pretty good tonight. Adds that when he got out, Rohit took over and went on the offensive. Continues saying he only has a few years left in his career, so he wants to give the game his all and do the best he can. On his seamers, reckons that the pitch was a good one to bat on so he doesn't want to be too harsh on the bowlers, though he acknowledges that they should have done better in the death overs.

Windies captain, Jason Holder, says he's really pleased with Shimron's Hetmyer's hundred and also the start Kieran Powell provided. Mentions the ball was skidding on which their spinners couldn't take advantage of. Thinks the total they had was par but Kohli and Rohit took the game away from them, though a wicket or two could have changed the game. Praises Hetmyer once more and applauds the youngster's character. Ends by saying they will look to bounce back in the next game.

Yuzvendra Chahal is caught on the sidelines by Sanjay Manjrekar. The leggie says you have to vary your pace on this ground. Feels the ball was gripping which helped. Reckons the batsmen were only looking for the big hits, so he wasn't bowling full too much. Adds the West Indians are strong guys and if they're hitting, you have to be smart. On playing with Jadeja, he mentions he's played with him in the Asia Cup so he knows him now and both were talking to each other throughout. On Kohli and Rohit's batting, he states the way they bat you don't want to bowl against them and it's a treat to watch them do what they do.

Windies were flavorless in their bowling. Yes, it was a batting track but nobody could get their lines right and they should have done better at least in terms of consistency. The tourists had an early wicket but didn't capitalize on it. All of them went for runs with Thomas and Bishoo picking up a wicket each. Earlier on, India were given a run for their money as Hetmyer (who scored a ton) and co. posted 320-plus on the board. One would have thought it would be a challenging total for the hosts, but that clearly wasn't the case.

India have won this game and have made it look so easy. Effortless. All thanks to Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli. They lost Dhawan early but their counter-attacking 246-run stand ensured that they took India within touching distance. Rayudu and Sharma then ensured that there were on further inroads.

SIX! And Rohit finishes it off in style as he gets to his 150! A comfortable victory for the hosts as Sharma lofts this full delivery in his arc cleanly over long off. Handshakes all around, the crowd goes wild. INDIA WIN BY 8 WICKETS!
Stays leg side to this full ball and pushes it through the gap in the covers for a single.
FOUR! Make that three in a row. Full toss on the stumps, Rohit lofts it cleanly over wide mid off to find the fence. Just 4 needed for India to win.
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries for Rohit Sharma. You don't usually see him playing such shot. He premeditates the shot, moves across and scoops it on the full past short fine leg.
FOUR! Full toss and Sharma dispatches that. Stands his ground and slogs it over mid-wicket. Hasn't middled it, but the ball still has enough legs to beat wide long on trying to cut it off.
Right in the blockhole from Oshane Thomas. Fires it in on middle, credit to Rohit too for bringing his bat down in time to keep it out.
Extremely full outside off, drilled through the covers for a single.
Opens his body up a bit and punches it through the gap in the covers for one. He will keep strike for the next over.
Smacks this full delivery just outside off to the left of long off and rotates strike.
Sliding in from around off, touch shorter in length, Rohit hangs back and keeps it out.
Ambati shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Outside off again, Rayudu plays it to point.
Short and wide outside off, cut away square on the off side. Dot ball.
Powerplay 3 signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the game. Also, debutant Chandrapaul Hemraj will have a go with the ball now.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
SIX! He's been rather patient so far, but now Ambati Rayudu just gives the charge to the pacer. Jumps out and smokes this fuller ball over long on for half a dozen.
In the channel outside off, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Wide! Wide down the leg side, the batsman leaves it alone. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Length delivery rising off the deck, well outside off, Ambati fails to punch it on the up.
Touch straight in line, flicked just wide of mid-wicket for an easy run.
Full and straight from Oshane, it's played back to him.
Played to the point region by the batsman. 29 needed from 66 for India to win.
Goes deep inside, waits for the ball to turn before defending it beside him on the track.
Spinning away from around off, blocked from inside the crease again.
Quicker one on off, forced from the crease on the off side.
FOUR! The timing is just immaculate. Tossed up on middle and leg, Rayudu gets his front leg out of the way and drives it sweetly past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary.
Too full outside off, the ball doesn't have enough room to turn. Rohit gets low and slogs it off the inner half to long on for one.
Attempted yorker which just misses. Rohit takes it on the full and drives it to long on for a run.
Rayudu plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Some room to work with, so Rohit Sharma places it behind point and changes ends.
Wide! Way down the leg side, Rohit moves across to scoop it but misses it altogether.
Opens the bat face and guides this length delivery down to third man for one run.
Drives this fuller ball to mid on.
Top edged and safe. Not that it would have mattered anyway. Length delivery outside off, Rohit backs away and swings, gets a top edge which falls in the third man region. Single to the total.

FOUR! Not a good start to the new spell from the pacer. Full and down the leg side, Rohit flicks it past the keeper and across the fine leg fence. There is an extra man outside the circle, so it's a no ball. Free Hit coming up...
Debutant Oshane Thomas comes back into the attack.
A bit quicker through the air, close to off, blocked out without any problem.
Short and wide, going away, cut through the covers for one.
SIX! Makes good use of the feet here. Sharma skips out, gets quite close to the pitch and lofts it cleanly over wide long off for a biggie.
Stays right behind the line and blocks it out.
Comes ahead to this tossed up ball and knocks it through mid off for a single.
Spinning away from off, defended from within the crease.
Full and angling in, flicked to deep mid-wicket. One run collected.
Just short of a length, around off, helps the pull in front of square leg and gets to the other end.
Yorker on the stumps, Sharma digs it out off the inner half back down the track.
Full in length, outside the line of off stump, driven but straight to the cover fielder.
Length ball outside off, Rayudu waits for this and runs it down to third man for a single.
In the channel outside off, on a length, no shot offered.
Keeps this out off the back foot and ends the over.
Turns it against the spin to the man at mid-wicket.
Oh! Completely misjudged that. Leg break, turning away from around off on a shorter length. Rohit goes back to heave but it takes the bottom edge and rolls to short third man.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Loopy leg break on off, eased to short cover.
Leans ahead, gets close to the pitch and drives it through covers for a run.
Moves inside the line and pulls it through backward square leg for another run.
Eases this with a punch through mid on for one.
SIX! Marginally short and Rohit has put this away. On the stumps, the opener picks the length up early, goes back and muscles the pull deep into the mid-wicket stands for a maximum.
Rayudu gets off the mark by working this ball square through the leg side for a run.
Shortish and into the body, pulled with a little swivel towards short fine leg for a single.
Back of a length around off, pushed away on the off side.
Drinks are on the field. Also, Ambati Rayudu is the next man in. And Jason Holder comes into the attack as well.

OUT! Kohli has to go. A well played innings comes to an end. Bishoo gives this air outside off, Kohli comes forward to drive this but gets beaten by the turn. Hope behind the stumps takes off the bails and Kohli is walking. The umpire takes it up but Kohli knows he is out. Windies breaks the 246-run stand. But is it too late? India need more 67 runs from 17 overs.
Stumping referral. Virat Kohli is the man in question. He looks gone, he's already started walking.
Outside off, well blocked by VK.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Everything they hit goes to the boundary. Tossed up ball outside off, Rohit gets an outside edge which goes fine to the third man fence. Boundary.
Rohit plays a pull shot to this short delivery. They manage to come back for the second.
Kohli charges down the wicket and hits it to the on side. The batsmen have run through for a single.

FOUR! WHAT A SHOT! So sweet, one would get diabetes. 100 for Rohit Sharma. Tossed up ball on off, Rohit just pushes this gently through covers and the ball runs to the fence. Rohit's 20th in this format. And he's got it faster than Kohli today. Who is playing 2nd fiddle?
Full and down leg, paddles this to fine leg for a brace.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
SIX! Short ball asking to be hit, Sharma rocks back and pulls this over square leg for another maximum. Rohit moves to 94 and this now the best stand between these two.
VK works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
SIX! India are making a mockery of this chase. Kohli comes forward to this loopy ball and just clips it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Rocks back and punches the ball to the off side for one.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Comes forward and works this back to the bowler.

FOUR! More boundaries. Short again outside off, Kohli goes back, transfers his weight onto his back foot and cuts this through covers for back-to-back boundaries. Tell you what, he is just 90 runs away from reaching 10K ODI runs.
FOUR! Just 99 needed now from 119 balls. Short ball and outside off, Kohli rocks back and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Spinning in from around off, played back to the bowler from within the crease.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot through mod-wicket. They pick up a single.
Straighter one outside off, Kohli looks to run this down late but gets beaten.
Flicks it away with the turn and gets a single.
Flat and quick on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
Short ball, slaps the pull down towards wide long on where the fielder makes a decent stop. Single taken.
FOUR! Make that 19 runs off the over. Power, elegance there is everything in them. Short ball outside off, Rohit lofts this over covers and the ball runs the fence.
FOUR! The 200-run stand is up with this pull shot. Roach digs this one short into Rohit who pulls this with disdain over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Deft. Virat opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
FOUR! SHOT! The stand moves to 198. Length ball around off, punched through covers for a delightful boundary.
SIX! Welcome to the bowling crease! No stopping them now. Full in line of the stumps, Kohli lofts this over mid-wicket for another maximum.
Kemar Roach is called on to bowl.
RS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
SIX! Sharma doesn't want to stay too far behind. Picks up this short ball and smokes this way back into the stands for a biggie.
Milked through mid on for one.
FOUR! They want to finish this off quickly. Short from Nurse outside off, Kohli square cuts this past point for a boundary.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Even better! Short and outside off, Kohli hops and cuts it over point for back-to-back boundaries.

FOUR! There it is! 37 ODI hundreds for Virat Kohli. 22nd while chasing. Full and outside off, Kohli leans forward and drives it crisply through covers. The fielder hares to his right but cannot stop the ball. India have won 19 of the games when Kohli has made a hundred while chasing.
Waiting for the bad ball. This one is in line of the stumps, the skipper blocks it.
Full and down leg, Kohli works it to the leg side. Stays on 97.
Short ball down leg, pulled to square leg for a run. Moves to 72 in no time.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

In the air... just over. Kohli must have had his heart in his mouth. Length ball which just grips off the surface. Kohli is early and his bottom hand comes off. The ball flies over mid-wicket where Rovman Powell dives full length to his left but cannot catch that. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. They pick up a single.
Punches this ball to the off side to rotate strike.
Sweeps this behind square for one.
Covers his stumps and blocks this.
FOUR! Now looks like Kohli is playing 2nd fiddle to Rohit. Full and outside off, Rohit drives this through covers as the ball races away to the fence.
Ashley Nurse is into the attack.
Rohit paddles the ball down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
RS has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Dealing in boundaries now. Too short from Bishoo who pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot to the fielder.
No damage done. Darts this full on leg. Sharma goes for the swing but fails to make contact.

NO BALL AND FOUR! This time for the field set. There were 5 fielders inside the ring than the mandatory 4. Full and outside off, Rohit makes room and drives this through covers. Another Free Hit coming up. The 150-run stand too is up.
NO BALL! For overstepping! Tosses this one up in line of the stumps, Sharma blocks it. Free Hit coming up..
Full and outside off, driven to covers by RS.
Back of a length ball outside off, Kohli bunts it down.
Rohit flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Beautifully done. Overpitched and strays onto Kohli's pads who uses his wrists and works it behind square for a boundary.
Similar length on leg, Kohli misses his tuck to get hit on his thigh pad.
Back of a length outside off, defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Darts this quicker one in line of the stumps, Rohit is solid in defense. 3 runs from the over.
Floated ball down leg, turned with the spin around the corner for one.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, pushed to long off for an easy run.
Loopy ball outside off, Kohli drives it past Bishoo and to long off to get off strike.
Gives this more air on off, once again hit to Bishoo.
Leg spinner around off, played back to the bowler.
FOUR! All class! A boundary to finish the over. 7 from it. Overpitched outside off, Rohit leans ahead and just pushes it gently through covers for a boundary.
Angles this into Kohli who helps it to square leg for another run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fifty for Rohit Sharma! His 37th in this format. Playing 2nd fiddle to Kohli and getting his runs quietly. Taps this with soft hands towards point and hares to the other end.
Length in line of the stumps, Rohit is happy to block it out.
Back of a length ball into the body of Kohli who gives Rohit the strike by tucking it to fine leg.
SIX! Back-to-back maximums for Rohit. Steps on the gas now. Sees this ball short and pulls it over square leg. Moves to 49 in no time.
SIX! HUGE! HUGE! Six on any ground. Loopy ball outside off, Rohit steps down and lofts this over long on for a big hit.
Leg spinner on middle and leg, turned to square leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up on leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around off, hit back to the bowler.
Good shot but just for one. Short and wide, cut to deep backward point. They cross.
Holder goes short again after seeing VK coming down the pitch. Kohli manages to hook it into the ground for one.
Safe shot, should have got a couple of runs but is happy with one. Short ball into the body, pulled over mid-wicket for one.
Length outside off, Sharma looks to run this down but connects with thin air.
Played with an angle bat towards third man for a run.
Full and down leg, Kohli works it behind square leg for an easy brace.
In line of the stumps, worked away on the leg side for one.
FOUR! Nicely done. Quick, flat and outside off, Virat Kohli cuts this late down and across the third man fence for a boundary.
Waits for the ball to come to him. Stays back and punches it to long off for a single.
Loopy and full on the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Tossed up a little bit outside off, Kohli gets close to the pitch, brings that bottom hand into play and whip-drives it through the covers for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Play and miss! Short and outside off, Rohit hops and looks to cut it but fails to get bat to ball.
Full and on the pads of Kohli who works it through square leg to give Rohit the strike. The 100-run stand is up. Great going.
FOUR! Moves to 69 with that boundary. Short ball on off, Kohli rocks back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary. Kohli is in a different mood today.
Full down leg, flicked to square leg for a single.
Full and around off, Sharma plays it with a straight bat.

Drinks break. After losing Dhawan early to the debutant Thomas, India have taken a strong hold of this game with a 94-run stand between Rohit and Kohli. The Indian skipper is looking in fine touch and for a change (between these two at least) is the aggressor. Windies need a wicket and they need it fast, otherwise they could run the risk of losing this game quite early.
Opens the face, dabs this with the spin square to point for no run.
Skids a bit after going off the surface, Kohli is rock solid in defense.
On the back foot as he slaps the pull to short mid-wicket.
Goes square on the leg side again, just wide of the fielder this time. A single results.
Flat, short and quick on middle and leg, Rohit picks it off his pads and works it to square leg.
Looped up leg break around off, Virat takes a big stride forward as he drives it to long off for a single.
Devendra Bishoo comes on to bowl. Windies need a wicket and he can most certainly provide that.
Played to the point region by the batsman. End of the over.
Camps onto the back foot and keeps it out on the off side.
Short of a good length outside off, played late and guided straight to short third man.
Kohli is standing well outside the crease. So he takes a step out and pulls it along the turf through mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Slightly fuller outside off, Rohit plays this late and runs it down towards third man for a single.
Landed on a good length, coming in on middle and leg, flicked through to deep mid-wicket. The batsmen cross over.
Short, flat and outside off, Kohli stays inside and cuts it towards sweeper cover. One run to end the over.
Goes with the spin as he closes the face and flicks it through backward square leg. Single taken.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects to place it to long on. They pick up a single.
Full in length, eased back down to long on for one run.
Straighter one just outside off, kept out from within the crease on the off side for a quick single.
Coming in on middle and leg, flicked square on the leg side for a single.
Full length on middle, Virat works it to the mid-wicket fielder.
Good length delivery on off, Sharma guides it through point for a single.
Full length on his pads, Virat tucks it to leg side for a single.
Just a tad short from Holder. Virat nicely defends it on his front foot.
Full length on middle, Virat drives it straight to mid on.
Length delivery on off, Rohit opens the face of the bat and taps it to third man for a single.
Width offered outside off, Rohit cuts this a bit square through cover-point. The sweeper moves to his left to cut it off and keep the batsmen down to one.
Shortish on middle and leg, Sharma works it in front of square leg.
Camps onto the back foot and wrists it through to deep mid-wicket. One to the total.
Nurse is just darting these in. Kohli taps it on the off side.
No spin on this one, on middle, turned to square leg. Dot ball.
Quicker one on middle and leg, Sharma turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Virat takes a step out of the crease to negate the swing and then pushes it to mid off.
Taps it in front of covers. Wants the run but then is sent back by Rohit. Good call.
Coming in at first and then going away, VK taps it down on the off side with an open face.
FOUR! Do not bowl there to him. Ever. He will always make you pay. Holders drifts onto the pads and Kohli leans ahead to flick it through the gap in the mid-wicket region. Boundary.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and keeps this back of a length ball at bay.
Shaping back in from outside off, on a good length, Virat looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide called by the umpire.
FOUR! A bad ball. From all angles. Nurse bowls it short on leg, Sharma goes back, swivels and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Rohit goes down the ground too, but on the other side. To long off for one more.
Short and on the stumps, punched to long on for a single.
FOUR! Just over and that's the 49th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli. Risky shot but he's pulled it off well enough. Short and wide, he goes back and cuts it over a leaping short third man for a boundary.
Short, flat and outside off, Kohli goes back to punch it down the track.
Powerplay 2 signalled. A maximum of 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the 40th over. Also, Ashley Nurse is on to roll his arm over.
Pushes this towards covers but the fielder stops it with a dive. Single taken.
FOUR! Poor start from Holder. Hasn't got his radar right yet. He sprays this onto the pads, Kohli flicks it well and through backward square leg for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Leans ahead to this fuller length ball and pushes it to mid off.
Length delivery on middle and off, wristed away on the leg side.
FOUR! Welcomes his counterpart with a boundary. Steps out and moves across to this length ball and flicks it through backward square leg for a boundary. Kohli is on song.
First change for Windies. Jason Holder is into the attack.
Rohit nicely defends it on front foot presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Full down leg, Rohit flicks it through square leg and the ball races away to the boundary. Also brings up the 50-run stand between these two.
Back of a length delivery on middle, Sharma defends it presenting the full face of the bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Good length delivery outside off, Virat opens the face of the bat and guides it to third man for a single.
Length delivery outside off, it goes off the edge of the hanging bat down to third man for a single.
Outside off, the batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
FOUR! Superb. That man oozes with class. Short and wide, Kohli doesn't have any qualms about it as he rocks back and cracks it over point for consecutive boundaries.
FOUR! In complete control as he does so. Short and angling in, Kohli predicts that and moves inside the line. Readies himself for it and pulls it through mid-wicket with complete control.
Back of a length outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Flashes at that and misses. Short of a good length rising off the deck, extra bounce for Thomas and he tempts Kohli to go for this. The Indian skipper flays at it and misses.
Length delivery on middle, Rohit tried to drive it but gets the thick inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls it to off side.
Full outside off, Virat pushes it through covers for a single.
FOUR! Short from Roach, Virat pulls it hard and the ball races away to the fine leg boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full on his pads, hits Sharma's pads and batsmen sneaks a single.
Back of a length delivery outisde off, the ball climbs high on Virat, gets the edge and the ball goes to third man for a single.
SIX! Just helped that away! Short ball into the body, Rohit swivels and then lifts the pull over square leg. The boundaries aren't as big on that side, so he clears the boundary with absolute ease.
Coming in at first before straightening up a shade, Kohli looks to play at it and it goes off the leading edge through covers. It won't go all the way, but it's enough for the batsmen to take three.
FOUR! This is a much better, more controlled shot. Full on middle, Kohli leans across and closes the face to flick this ball neatly through mid-wicket. No stopping that one, the timing is that good.

Edged and FOUR! Once again Thomas extracting some good bounce. Crossing the 140-mark, a length ball outside off. Takes the outside edge of Virat Kohli's hanging bat and runs across the third man boundary.
Cutting back in from a good length on middle and leg, strikes Rohit on the pads who looks to flick. It falls on the off side and a leg bye is stolen.
Spears it full and just outside off, driven right back to the bowler.
Fuller in length and on off stump, blocked from the front foot.
Using the short ball against Kohli here, clearly a plan. It's well-directed as it's angling in on middle and leg, ducked and evaded.
On the fuller side of the length, defended down in front of cover.
Straightening up outside off, pushed away with hard hands to the man at point.
FOUR! In the air but it's in the gap. Full and angling in on middle, Kohli moves a step across and flicks this aerially through the gap in the mid-wicket area for a boundary.
Angling back in on off, on a good length, defended from inside the crease on the leg side for a single. Rohit leaned a touch across too to counter the angle.
At 144 kph, rising off the surface as Oshane pitches it outside off. VK has nothing to do with it.
Back of a length around off, kept out off the back foot.
FOUR! Errs in line on this occasion, Kohli has no trouble nudging this down the leg side. Gets it fine enough and beats the fielder in the deep.
Generating good pace here. At 143 clicks, Thomas bangs it on a shortish length, Kohli covers the line and leaves.
Bumper outside off, Virat keeps his eyes on the ball and lets it go.
Targets the off stick with a length delivery on off, Kohli moves inside the line and wrists it behind square leg. Takes two runs as fine leg cuts it off.
On a length, close to off, blocked with the full face of the bat.
Length delivery on off, wristed in front of square leg for a single. Kohli is off the mark.
Kohli walks a step across after getting out of his crease and punches it square to point.
Length ball on off, gets an inside edge onto the leg side for a single.
A nice, firm punch from Rohit but can't beat the fielder. Short of a length outside off, Sharma plays it to the man at cover-point.
Outside off on a good length, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Virat Kohli walks in at no.3.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! First wicket down for India in the same manner as Windies lost theirs. Debutant Oshane Thomas gets his first wicket in ODI cricket and what a wicket too, of Shikhar Dhawan. Short and close to off, Dhawan rises to cut this away but gets a bottom edge back onto the stumps. The Zing bails light up and the dangerous southpaw has to make the long walk back. Windies make a great start in this second innings.
Cutting back in from a good length, on leg, raps Dhawan on the pads as he looks to play across the line. Loud shout for leg before, but it's turned down.
Shaping away from around off, played to point.
Yorker fired in on the stumps, dug out well by Dhawan from inside the crease.
FOUR! Breaks the shackles with that. A flying start from Dhawan. Full and outside off, has room to free his arms so he throws his bat at it. Gets it past point and finds the fence.
Full and on off, driven to mid off.
Debutant Oshane Thomas to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
FOUR! Edge and four! Length outside off, Rohit goes for the drive but gets a outside which flies to the third man region for the first boundary.
Length on middle and leg, Rohit taps this to the on side and quickly sets off for a run. Hetmyer at square leg has a shy at the striker's end but misses. They take a run on the overthrows.
Angles this into Rohit who goes for the flick but misses to get hit on his pads.
Full and in line of the stumps, Rohit plays it with a straight bat.
Closer to the off pole, Sharma cuts it to point.
Starts off by bowling one way outside off and short too. Rohit cuts it to point. Would have been a wide if he would have let it go.
We are back for the chase. Rohit Sharma and Shikhar Dhawan to open for India while Kemar Roach takes the new ball.
